scope: CPU plan_native_prefill with real causal/request identity handling, using each variant's exact plan and compiler source, mixed restoration sources and deterministic stub-native residency. Logical time advances past the 50ms observation cache each iteration. Alternating variants must agree on both plans, cumulative policy counters and promotion metadata. Inspection traces must retain all unaged reads; only already-aged arrival-order requests may skip residency reads. Counts include warmup iterations. No real allocator, DMA, CUDA or end-to-end throughput is measured.
